Title: Waste Management Operation/Deal with the Devil/Vast Wealth combo question

Messages.Author: legbiter
Messages.Body:
As some of you will know, i have it in mind to run a "protected"
Sabbat Wars promotional tournament. "Protected" means that it's aimed
at Newbies, each of whom will get a clan-themed deck provided by me.
The decks are meant to be balanced with respect to each other so's
to provide the purest possible test of playing skill. But mainly
it's about giving people loadsa cards in the form of playable decks,
and a secondary aim is to make sure there are NO text-errata'd cards
in the decks so's not to put people off.

As i was building the !Brujah deck it struck me that i need the answer
to a rules question. i was thinking of putting Waste Management Operation,
Deal with the Devil and Vast Wealth in, the idea obviously being to make
your ash-heap into your future hand. The question is, if you have run out
of library cards can you still do the WMO trick? i think you may not be
allowed to, because there is no target "bottom of your library" for the
card's effect. Am i right?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
legbiter wrote:
> As i was building the !Brujah deck it struck me that i need the answer
> to a rules question. i was thinking of putting Waste Management Operation,
> Deal with the Devil and Vast Wealth in, the idea obviously being to make
> your ash-heap into your future hand. The question is, if you have run out
> of library cards can you still do the WMO trick? i think you may not be
> allowed to, because there is no target "bottom of your library" for the
> card's effect. Am i right?

The bottom of an empty library still exists. WMO can still be used to
return a card to an empty library.

Messages.Author: jeroen rombouts
Messages.Body:
Can you go though your library to find
*a weapon (Arm's dealer, Horrid Reality, Terrrorists)
* equipment (Vast Wealth, Magic of the Smith)
*Giant's Blood (Bindusara, Historian of the Kindred)
....
when you know the card(s) your looking for are not in your deck?

This is important when playing with WMO. Can you return your Deflection to
your library and then shuffle, hoping to draw it back soon?

Jeroen

Messages.Author: Andy Brown
Messages.Body:


I would say yes, as your opponent doesn't know whether they are there
or not.

However, if the card states you must obtain equipment from the deck,
then this would mean that you couldn't.

Just my own way of playing (derived from magic, in which you can do
this in a similar strategy idea, and it is legal)

Andy (setitesuk)

I assume you must be able to. Otherwise, people with CRS are at
a distinct advantage when playing with such cards. There are no
sanctions on the cards or in the game rules for looking through your
deck for a card that didn't turn out to be in there. So I don't see
how it can matter where you did so knowingly or were on your 15th
Cuba Libre at the time or what.

I guess so.
